title: Finish Hub Spaces Collaboration End to End
description: Finish the work started in 26/08/16/HUB-SPACES-LIVE-PRESENCE-AND-COLLABORATIVE-STUDIOS (whose folder was subsequently renamed by another session into 26/08/16/PRESERVE-SEEDED-DIALOG-CONTEXT-ARGUMENTS — all 30+ lane reports and the final summary are still in there and are the history for this work). Remaining: drive the browser collab e2e from 2/8 to all 8 steps, starting from the plugin-instance-busy / missing HistorySnapshot retry storm in PluginRuntime; fix the 🛢️db crate's empty sqlite/postgres/neo4j feature wiring so the postgres and neo4j directory backends actually compile and --all-features works again; port auto check-in, checkpoint-on-close and TouchArtifact to the wgpu shell and actually observe it running; and clear the remaining plugin crates that fail to build for wasm so dev s boots the full catalogue.
